scenes.narration: 最近人民币汇率一路走高，刷到网上不少人开始欢呼：升值多好啊，说明咱们国家实力变强了！
scenes.core_idea: 人民币升值引发网络欢呼的情绪现象
scenes.visual_strategy: 手机屏幕滚动多条欢呼评论拼贴，配合汇率K线飙升动画

The hand enters frame, finger hovering, then pulls back slightly. No camera cut. scenes.narration: 手里钱更值钱，出国旅游、买大牌都更划算啦。先别急着跟着开心。
scenes.core_idea: 表面利好之下隐藏转折，情绪从亢奋转为警示
scenes.visual_strategy: 机票订单、奢侈品购物车画面逐步被红色警告标记覆盖，色彩从暖黄转向冷灰

scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same split composition but now red caution marks stamp across both panels, colors cool down to navy and gray, the booking page shows declining numbers, shopping prices drop but so does a profit indicator, halftone texture persists
scenes.video_prompt: Static wide shot with split panel composition. Left panel: flight prices tick up, right panel: luxury goods price tags shown. Red warning stamps animate across both panels one by one. Warm mustard tones gradually desaturate to cold gray. Halftone overlay remains constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 如果你主要靠工资过日子，或是做外贸、搞出海相关生意，那这次升值，未必是天上掉馅饼，搞不好会直接冲击到你的饭碗。
scenes.core_idea: 升值对特定人群的潜在冲击
scenes.visual_strategy: 三组人物场景快速切换：上班族刷工资条、外贸老板看账本、工人收拾物品，用纸张撕裂转场
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Three-panel paper collage: top shows a white-collar worker's payslip with a downward arrow, middle shows an export factory owner staring at a ledger, bottom shows a factory worker folding a name badge; navy blue and warm gray tones, halftone texture, archival newspaper print aesthetic, 16:9 cinematic
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same three-panel composition but now the payslip shows thinner numbers, the ledger has red ink marks crossing out profits, the worker's hands are mid-fold holding the badge; colors slightly darker, halftone texture unchanged
scenes.video_prompt: Paper collage animation: three panels visible simultaneously. Top panel: finger traces down a declining salary figure. Middle panel: red pen circles losses in a ledger. Bottom panel: hands fold a work badge slowly. Panels remain in fixed positions. No cut. Halftone texture and navy-mustard-gray palette persist. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 很多人都有一个很直观的误区：货币变强，就等于我们个人的钱包变厚。但现实并不是这样。
scenes.core_idea: 汇率走强不等于个人财富增长
scenes.visual_strategy: 一个鼓胀的钱袋被针扎破，金币漏出，露出里面空心的纸壳结构
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: A leather coin purse bulging visibly, sitting on a wooden desk under warm desk lamp light, gold coins spilling slightly from the opening, paper collage texture, halftone grain, muted mustard and navy tones, editorial documentary style, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same purse now punctured with a needle hole at the side, coins draining out onto the desk, revealing hollow cardboard interior; lighting slightly dimmer, same halftone texture and color palette maintained
scenes.video_prompt: Close-up static shot of the coin purse. A needle刺入画面，扎进钱袋侧面。金币开始从破口缓缓漏出，散落桌面。镜头轻微缓慢推进。钱袋内纸板结构隐约可见。保持暖黄与海军蓝色调和halftone纹理。no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 汇率从来不是用来撑面子的指标，本质上就是国与国之间利益博弈的调节阀门。
scenes.core_idea: 汇率是利益博弈的调节工具
scenes.visual_strategy: 机械齿轮系统动画，齿轮代表不同国家，阀门口流出的是彩色液体（资本）
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Mechanical valve system with interlocking brass gears of various sizes, colored liquid flowing through transparent pipes between gears, blueprint-style annotations, halftone texture on paper background, muted mustard yellow and navy blue palette, editorial documentary paper collage style, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same mechanical system but now one gear slows down while another speeds up, liquid flow direction shifts, pressure gauges fluctuate, annotations highlight the valve mechanism, halftone texture and color scheme unchanged
scenes.video_prompt: Static medium shot of the mechanical valve diagram. Brass gears rotate at different speeds. Colored liquid flows through transparent pipes between them. One gear gradually slows, another accelerates. Flow direction shifts visually. Pressure gauges move. Blueprint annotations fade in and out. Halftone texture and muted palette remain constant throughout. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 打个比方，汇率就像高压水枪的喷嘴。把喷嘴拧紧，喷出去的水流冲击力确实更强，但水管内部承受的压力会急剧变大。
scenes.core_idea: 升值短期看似强势，但内部压力剧增
scenes.visual_strategy: 高压水枪喷嘴特写：拧紧喷嘴，水流变细但冲击力增强，水管接头处开始渗出
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Close-up of a high-pressure water gun nozzle in a workshop setting, hands tightening the nozzle ring clockwise, water spray becomes narrower and more forceful, workshop shelves with tools in background, halftone texture, navy blue and warm gray tones, editorial documentary style, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same nozzle but now water begins leaking from the hose joint behind the nozzle, pressure gauge on the hose body showing red zone, hands still gripping the trigger, same workshop environment and color palette
scenes.video_prompt: Extreme close-up on the water gun nozzle. Hands tighten the ring clockwise. Water spray narrows and intensifies. Pressure gauge needle moves into the red zone. A drip appears at the hose joint, then a steady leak. Camera holds steady. Halftone texture and muted mustard-navy palette remain. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 水管哪里薄弱，哪里就最先扛不住。哪些地方最脆弱？就是抗风险能力弱的中小制造老板、利润微薄靠退税撑着的外贸工厂，还有依附在这条产业链上，随时可能被裁员优化的普通人。
scenes.core_idea: 压力传导至产业链薄弱环节
scenes.visual_strategy: 多米诺骨牌式动画：第一块牌子写"汇率升值"，依次推倒"中小制造""外贸工厂""普通工人"三组
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Domino chain setup on a wooden table: first domino labeled with exchange rate symbol tips forward, three subsequent dominoes stand ready labeled with factory silhouette, ledger icon, and worker silhouette; paper cutout style, halftone texture, muted mustard and navy blue palette, archival collage aesthetic, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: First domino has fallen, second domino is mid-tipping, third and fourth still standing but beginning to wobble; same paper cutout style, halftone texture, and color scheme maintained
scenes.video_prompt: Top-down static shot of the domino chain on a wooden table. The first domino (exchange rate symbol) falls forward, triggering the second domino (factory icon) to tip. The second falls onto the third (ledger icon). The chain reaction continues with slight delay. Paper cutout style with halftone texture persists. Colors stay in muted mustard-navy-gray range. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 这一轮人民币为什么会走强？那些各种阴谋论听听就好，不用当真。汇率归根到底看两件事：利差，还有市场的风险偏好。
scenes.core_idea: 人民币升值的主因是利差收窄和风险偏好变化
scenes.visual_strategy: 时间轴图表：美联储利率下降曲线 vs 人民币升值曲线并排呈现
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Dual-axis line chart on a corkboard pinned with papers: left curve shows Federal Reserve interest rates declining from ~5% to lower, right curve shows RMB appreciation index rising; halftone texture, muted mustard and navy blue palette, archival newspaper print style, paper pin shadows, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same corkboard chart but now both curves are fully drawn, a dashed red line connects the peak of one curve to the rise of the other, indicating correlation; same pinned paper aesthetic and halftone texture
scenes.video_prompt: Static shot of the corkboard. Two line curves draw themselves progressively from left to right. Fed rate curve slopes downward, RMB appreciation curve slopes upward. A dashed red correlation line animates connecting the inflection points. Paper pins cast soft shadows. Halftone texture and muted palette constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 一方面美联储开启降息，美元资产曾经接近5%的无风险高收益优势在消退，全球海量套息资本开始撤离。
scenes.core_idea: 美联储降息导致套息资本撤离
scenes.visual_strategy: 热力学系统类比图：高温区域（美元）温度下降，低温区域（人民币资产）相对变暖，粒子开始流动
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Thermodynamic visualization: two connected chambers, left chamber glowing warm orange labeled USD, right chamber cooler blue labeled RMB assets; particle dots begin migrating from left to right through a connecting pipe, halftone texture, paper diagram aesthetic, muted mustard and navy palette, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Left chamber's orange glow fades to amber, right chamber warms slightly, particle flow intensifies through the pipe, temperature gauge on left drops visibly; same diagram style and halftone texture maintained
scenes.video_prompt: Static diagram view of the two-chamber thermodynamic system. Left chamber orange glow dims progressively. Particle dots begin moving through the connecting pipe from left to right. Flow accelerates. Temperature gauge needle drops on the left chamber. Right chamber gains slight warmth. Halftone texture and muted palette constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 另一方面，前些年一直留在海外没回来的大量出口结汇资金，看到行情变化，纷纷换回人民币。不是谁刻意造就的结果，纯粹就是资本逐利而已。
scenes.core_idea: 出口结汇资金回流是逐利行为而非人为操纵
scenes.visual_strategy: 资金流向动画：海外账户图标中的数字流向人民币账户，箭头清晰标注方向
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Two account icons side by side on a paper map background: left icon shows overseas account with dollar symbols slowly draining out, right icon shows RMB account filling up with coins; arrows animate the flow direction, halftone texture, muted mustard and navy palette, archival collage style, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same composition but now the overseas account is nearly empty, the RMB account is significantly fuller, multiple arrows show continuous flow, a small label reads "profit-seeking capital"; halftone texture and colors unchanged
scenes.video_prompt: Static overhead shot of the paper map background. Dollar symbols animate out of the left account icon. Coins fill the right RMB account icon. Flow arrows appear sequentially. Account balances change numerically. Label "profit-seeking capital" fades in. Halftone texture and muted palette remain consistent. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 历史总是相似。回想1985年日本广场协议之后，日元短短三年近乎翻倍，当时一派繁荣景象，可制造业利润被快速侵蚀，热钱疯狂涌入楼市股市，直接埋下失落三十年的伏笔。
scenes.core_idea: 日本广场协议后的历史教训：升值短期内制造繁荣幻象，长期侵蚀制造业根基
scenes.visual_strategy: 档案拼贴：1980年代日本报纸头条、日元升值图表、股市楼市泡沫照片，叠加红色裂缝扩散效果
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Archival newspaper collage from 1980s Japan: front page headlines about yen appreciation, stock market boom photos, real estate price charts spiking upward; red crack lines beginning to spread from bottom corners, halftone texture, muted mustard and navy palette on off-white paper background, editorial documentary archive style, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same collage but red cracks have spread further across the newspaper images, a faint shadow of an empty factory building overlays the stock chart, the once-booming numbers now have a faded quality; halftone texture and color palette maintained
scenes.video_prompt: Slow push-in toward the archival newspaper collage. Red crack lines animate outward from the corners like spreading fractures. A factory silhouette slowly fades in over the stock chart. Newspaper headlines remain visible but gain a faded, ghostly quality. Halftone texture and muted mustard-navy-gray palette constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 再看我们2005年汇改，人民币开启升值周期。那时候刚加入WTO，人口红利充足，全球产能向国内转移，才扛住了升值带来的压力。
scenes.core_idea: 2005年汇改时中国有独特条件缓冲升值冲击
scenes.visual_strategy: 2005年时间轴：WTO标志、工厂建设画面、人口结构图，与当前时间轴并排对比
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Side-by-side timeline panels on a paper background: left panel shows 2005 with WTO logo, factory construction photos, and population pyramid chart glowing green; right panel shows current year with similar icons but dimmed; halftone texture, muted mustard and navy blue tones, archival newspaper collage style, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same dual-timeline panels but now the right (current) panel has a question mark stamp over the factory icon, the left panel remains bright; a dividing line with arrows indicates comparison; halftone texture and color scheme unchanged
scenes.video_prompt: Static split composition. Left timeline panel (2005) glows brighter with WTO logo, factory photos, and green population chart. Right timeline panel (current) is dimmer with the same icons but faded. A question mark stamp animates over the right panel's factory icon. Arrows between panels indicate comparison. Halftone texture and muted palette persist. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 放到今天，我们还能靠同样的条件去消化这波变化吗？客观看待这把双刃剑。
scenes.core_idea: 当前条件已不同，需理性看待升值的双面性
scenes.visual_strategy: 一把双刃剑实体道具：正面反射"进口成本下降"的光芒，背面映照"出口利润缩水"的阴影
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: A double-edged sword lying horizontally on a dark wooden table, one edge reflecting warm golden light labeled with import cost decline icons, the other edge casting a cool navy shadow with export profit shrinking symbols; halftone texture, muted mustard and navy palette, editorial documentary still life style, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same sword but now the golden reflection fades slightly while the navy shadow deepens; a hand enters frame holding the hilt, neither lifting nor dropping; same table, lighting, and halftone texture maintained
scenes.video_prompt: Static close-up of the double-edged sword on the wooden table. Golden light reflection on one edge gradually dims. Navy shadow on the other edge deepens. A hand enters from the bottom of frame, grips the hilt but does not lift the sword. Camera holds steady. Halftone texture and muted palette constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects
sound_effects: fabric of glove on leather wrap

scenes.narration: ✅宏观层面的利好：进口石油、铁矿石、粮食这类大宗商品成本下降，可以缓解输入型通胀；同时减轻外债压力，也有利于人民币资产被全球更多接纳。
scenes.core_idea: 升值在宏观层面的三个积极影响
scenes.visual_strategy: 三张档案卡片依次翻起：石油桶降价标签、铁矿进口船、外债数字下降曲线
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Three archival index cards fanned out on a desk surface: card one shows an oil barrel with a dropping price tag, card two shows a cargo ship unloading iron ore, card three shows a declining debt curve; halftone texture, muted mustard and navy tones, paper collage aesthetic, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: All three cards fully flipped open to reveal detailed data visuals — price tag dropped significantly, ship unloading faster, debt curve steepened downward; same desk, lighting, and halftone texture maintained
scenes.video_prompt: Static overhead shot of three index cards fanned on a desk. Card one flips open to reveal oil barrel with falling price tag. Card two flips to show cargo ship and iron ore. Card three flips to display declining debt curve. Each card flip is smooth and deliberate. Halftone texture and muted palette constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: ⚠️但落到普通人、中小商家身上的压力非常现实：不少代工工厂利润率也就3-5%，汇率只要升值3个点，一整年忙活下来利润直接归零。
scenes.core_idea: 微小利润空间被汇率波动轻易吞噬
scenes.visual_strategy: 计算器动画：输入利润数字3%，乘以汇率变化系数，结果归零；旁边放着一本翻旧的账本
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Close-up of a worn accountant's ledger open on a desk, next to a calculator displaying "3% profit margin"; a hand is about to press the equals key, warm desk lamp illuminates the scene, halftone texture, muted mustard and navy tones, editorial documentary still life, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same scene but the calculator now reads "0" after the operation, the hand has moved away, the ledger shows rows of crossed-out numbers, lamp light slightly dimmer; halftone texture and palette maintained
scenes.video_prompt: Close-up static shot of the ledger and calculator. Hand presses the equals key. Calculator display changes from "3%" to "0". The hand slowly withdraws. Ledger pages show red-crossed figures. Lamp light dims marginally. Halftone texture and muted palette constant throughout. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 我认识一个做跨境电商的朋友，前两年靠着美元结算赚到第一桶金。今年汇率反转，再叠加上海外退货变多，上周喝酒聊天，他苦笑说：辛辛苦苦干一整年，到头来都给汇率波动打工了。
scenes.core_idea: 个体被汇率波动吞噬的具体故事
scenes.visual_strategy: 两杯啤酒对放，手机屏幕亮起显示汇率曲线暴跌，窗外夜色渐深
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Two beer glasses clinking on a dim restaurant table, a smartphone screen glowing between them showing a steep downward exchange rate curve, warm amber light from overhead, night visible through window behind, halftone texture, muted mustard and navy palette, editorial documentary scene, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same table but now the phone screen shows the curve flatlining, one glass is empty, the other half-empty, the man's hand rests near his forehead, the night outside darker, halftone texture and color scheme unchanged
scenes.video_prompt: Medium close-up of the restaurant table. Two beer glasses catch amber light. Phone screen glows between them showing the falling curve. One glass empties slowly. A hand rises to touch the forehead. Night darkens outside the window. Camera holds steady. Halftone texture and muted palette constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 他踩的坑，就是把宏观周期带来的红利，当成了自己本身的硬实力。
scenes.core_idea: 混淆外部红利与自身能力的危险
scenes.visual_strategy: 一面镜子反射出穿着西装的成功形象，转身却发现镜子后面只是一张打印纸贴在墙上
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: A full-length mirror on a wall reflects a sharply dressed business person standing confidently, warm office lighting, halftone texture, muted mustard and navy tones, editorial documentary portrait style, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same mirror but the reflection is now a printed photograph taped to the mirror surface, the person is looking away from the mirror at a plain wall behind, the confident pose is broken; halftone texture and palette maintained
scenes.video_prompt: Medium shot of the mirror reflecting the confident business figure. The figure slowly turns away from the mirror. Camera follows the turn to reveal the mirror surface has a printed photo taped to it — the reflection was never real. The wall behind is plain and bare. Halftone texture and muted palette constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 如果只是被动面对周期，行情好就欢呼，行情差就网上吐槽，那永远摆脱不了被环境裹挟的处境。真正清醒的人，不会去赌汇率涨跌预测，而是搭建一套不管外部行情怎么波动，自己都不容易垮掉的反脆弱体系。
scenes.core_idea: 建立反脆弱体系才是应对不确定性的正确方式
scenes.visual_strategy: 建筑蓝图动画：地基一层层加固，砖块从单点堆叠变为网格结构

scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Blueprint fully revealed showing complete grid foundation with all three layers interlocked, a small structure on top stands firm, wind lines outside the frame suggest turbulence but the building holds; same blueprint style and halftone texture
scenes.video_prompt: Top-down shot of the blueprint on the drafting table. Pencil lines draw the foundation grid layer by layer. Labels appear: "currency diversification" → "high value skills" → "hedging tools". Layers interlock visually. A small structure rises on top. Wind lines animate around the edges suggesting turbulence. The structure remains stable. scenes.narration: 第一，不要把全部身家押在单一货币、单一资产上面。收入是人民币，也可以趁着周期位置，合理配置具备全球价值的硬通货类资产。
scenes.core_idea: 资产配置多元化以降低单一货币风险
scenes.visual_strategy: 多个篮子排列，鸡蛋从单一篮子分散到多个篮子，篮子标注不同货币符号
scenes.image_prompt_first_frame: Row of five wooden baskets on a shelf, each labeled with a currency symbol (RMB, USD, EUR, gold, crypto); a hand is transferring eggs from the first basket into the others, warm workshop lighting, halftone texture, muted mustard and navy tones, editorial documentary still life, 16:9
scenes.image_prompt_last_frame: Same five baskets but now each has an equal number of eggs, the first basket is nearly empty, the hand withdraws; warm lighting and halftone texture unchanged
scenes.video_prompt: Static medium shot of five labeled baskets on a shelf. A hand systematically transfers eggs from the RMB-labeled basket into the other four baskets one by one. Each basket ends up with roughly equal eggs. The hand withdraws slowly. Halftone texture and muted palette constant. no background music, no soundtrack, only natural diegetic sound effects

scenes.narration: 第二，尽量往高附加值方向沉淀自己。简单代工、出卖标准化体力劳动，汇率浮动两三个点就可能生存困难。但拥有品牌、技术壁垒、IP内容这类高价值产出，就拥有转移成本的议价权。
scenes.core_idea: 提升个人价值和不可替代性以应对汇率波动
scenes.visual_strategy: 两个价签对比：旧价签写着"标准化劳动"被撕下，新价签"品牌+技术+IP"覆盖上去
